title: 层递
summary: 看板该从结果往下钻。一盘端上 KPI、图、表，扫得到皮，钻不到因。
summaryEn: The board should drill from the result. Serve KPI, chart, and table on one platter and you can scan the skin, not the cause.
asks: 看板从结果往下钻，还是一盘端上来？
asksEn: Does the board drill from the result, or serve everything on one platter?

links.whenEn: drilling is not switching the mark
layers are not a dashboard skin
